sn2.25:1.2: Normally _kuṭikā_ is understood as a diminutive of _kuṭi_, hence “little hut”. But here several mendicants are staying (as at [ud4.2:1.3]()), while elsewhere the Buddha stayed in one while at the Jetavana ([dn14:1.1.2]()). More likely the suffix here does not change the meaning of _kuṭi_.
sn2.25:2.1: The deity Jantu (“personage”, “man”, “offspring”) cannot be identified.
sn2.25:4.4: Monks falling asleep inappropriately is addressed in the Vinaya ([pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5](), [pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:2.1.1](), [pli-tv-kd8:16.1.1](); see also [pli-tv-kd1:7.2.2]()). | _Mucchita_ in Pali usually means “infatuated, besotted”, but the normal meaning of Sanskrit _mūrchita_ is “fainted, passed out”.
